questions.instructions: Show all the necessary steps in the space provided for each of the following questions. (3 pts each)

items.text:
Evaluate the following limit
$$\lim_{(x,y) \to (0,0)} \frac{x^2 y^2}{x^3 + y^3}$$

Find and classify all the critical points of the function
$$f(x,y) = x^2 + y^2 + xy + x + y + 1$$
Evaluate $\int_{0}^{\pi} \int_{y}^{\pi} \sin(x^2) \, dx \, dy$. (Hint: change the order of integration)
